publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.4.2 is ready for Business-provisioned installations: when Run Edit Run installs Uptime for an approved Business plan, the owner's first claim opens the Business import door; self-hosted deploys keep it off, and the owner can switch it off and on under Runner / archive. Run Edit Run can read the private runner's contact state (fresh, stale or never) through a signed runner-status request that never returns the runner key. Upgrading a 0.4.0 installation now keeps the session and runner keys it actually uses when its saved settings move into rer, with no manual step. On slow connections the console keeps its theme while moving between the monitor list and the monitor editor, and the slow-response guide link is a full-size touch target before its panel styles load. No new migrations or required settings; this patch pins rer 0.2.66. Back up before upgrading. Monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept. Known issue: a response body over 64 KiB fails the check, so monitor a smaller page such as a health endpoint. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
